name: Assist For WCAG
description: Injects an external, token-authenticated accessibility-widget script from dockaccess.org into front-end pages, with an admin form to store the token.
project_description: Assist for WCAG helps site owners deliver more inclusive experiences by embedding a hosted accessibility widget on their front-end pages. The module is intentionally minimal: an administrator enters a single token on a settings form, and the module then injects a remote script (https://dockaccess.org/accessibility/<token>/start.js) into the HTML head of every non-admin page. The remote widget provides visitor-facing assistive controls such as color inversion, contrast enhancement, font-size adjustment, and accessibility profiles for needs like ADHD, dyslexia, and low vision. Because the script is served remotely, the widget updates automatically without a module release. The module ships one settings route (/admin/config/user-interface/assist-for-wcag) gated by 'administer site configuration', a menu link under Configuration > User interface, and a small admin CSS library. It has no plugins, services, hooks beyond hook_page_attachments, permissions, or config schema. Supports Drupal 10, 11, and 12 on PHP 8.1+. Requires a valid token and outbound HTTPS access to dockaccess.org; the widget itself is a third-party overlay with its own privacy and effectiveness considerations.
